description: This file appears to be a C header file defining functions and constants related to quoting strings for shell safety, including quoting paths, command arguments, and various language-specific string literal quoting methods. It also provides functions for dequoting and quoting in different styles, aimed at safe shell command construction and string handling.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety into a provided strbuf buffer.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments for shell safety into a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style arguments for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Pretty variant of sq_quote_buf, avoiding quoting for safe characters.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Pretty variant of sq_quote_argv, avoiding quoting for safe characters.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends pretty-quoted arguments to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Removes quotes from a string produced by sq_quote functions.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single item and provides a pointer to the next position.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argv array, modifying in place.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a string vector, duplicating strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Unquotes a C-style quoted string into a strbuf.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C style, possibly with no double quotes if safe.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C style as a pair.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a name quoted for shell safety to a FILE.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative quoted name based on a prefix.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a given prefix for shell safety.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl string literals.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl with explicit length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Tcl string literal.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in regular expressions.
